title: Quickstart Snapshot Map and Step Syndication
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a compact, exportable ‘snapshot map’ for the Quickstart landing page that sequences key steps, supports adaptive screenshots (mobile/tablet/desktop), and produces syndicated assets for docs, release notes, and marketing. Deliverables: hero snapshot map, modular step cards, motion keyframes for micro-interactions, automated export templates, and a handoff package for engineering and content teams.
design_notes: Goal: create a single canonical visual system (snapshot map) that can be programmatically sliced into screenshot sets for different channels. Priorities: clarity of flow, minimal visual noise, consistent grid for screenshot cropping, and accessible microcopy. Consideration: keep hero above the fold under 1200px wide, with a condensed path for mobile. Use tokenized spacing so Product can tweak stage counts without redrawing assets.

acceptance_criteria: Hero snapshot map approved by PM and Design Lead
Responsive screenshot set exports generated for 320x180 (mobile), 1280x720 (desktop), and 800x800 (square) with correct safe-area margins
Motion micro-interaction prototype (GIF/MP4) demonstrates step reveal and focus transitions
Handoff package includes token list, export manifest, and accessibility checklist
Engineering has a clear spec for automated cropping and naming conventions
review_feedback: PM: Prefer condensed step count display when steps > 5 to avoid visual clutter
Eng: Provide crop-safe guides for any UI overlays and avoid translucent gradients near edges
Design Lead: Use semi-flat shadows for depth; avoid heavy skeuomorphic details to keep exports consistent across channels
decisions: Adopt Variant C (stacked modular tiles) as canonical snapshot map
Use tokenized spacing and a 12-column grid for consistent cropping and layout
Export presets: mobile 4:3 crop with 16px safe margin; desktop 16:9 full-bleed; square 1:1 center crop
Motion duration: 240ms for step entrance, 120ms for micro-focus pulse
